target_customer: Executive search and recruiting firms and enterprise recruiters that coordinate interview panels
problem: Scheduling one interview panel takes many emails and reschedules. Vela is CC'd on the thread and handles outreach, follow-ups, rescheduling and confirmation over email, SMS and WhatsApp.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for recruiting scheduling coordination (pricing not found)

founders.name: Gobhanu Sasankar Korisepati
education: Wharton Huntsman Program, left to work on Vela

founders.name: Saatvik Suryajit Korisepati
education: Carnegie Mellon, BS CS and IS
University of Chicago Booth, MBA/MS CS, dropped out
founders.background_notes: Z Fellow per YC page. Brother of the CEO per a secondary profile.

competitors.name: GoodTime
competitors.what: Interview scheduling platform for talent teams, launched Cori AI coordination agent

competitors.name: Joveo
competitors.what: AI Scheduling for interview coordination across web, email, SMS and WhatsApp

competitors.name: Kula
competitors.what: AI Coordinator voice agent that calls candidates to book interviews

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-party negotiation across email, SMS and WhatsApp with calendar integrations, time zones and reschedules; reliability matters but it builds on existing models and calendar APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Claims training on recruiting scheduling data and a niche focus on executive search, but many vendors shipped AI scheduling agents in 2026.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents launched AI scheduling agents in 2026 (GoodTime Cori and Joveo in May 2026). Vela is still operating with active job postings.

market_need_then: GoodTime reported talent teams spend about 38% of their time on coordination (company-reported). Executive search coordination is multi-party and manual.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryvela.ai rather than vela.com. Unrelated companies named Vela, including the VC firm Vela Partners, exist.

identity.mascot_or_character: Product is personified as a woman named Vela, referred to as she on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise, direct address, for example the headline Scheduling, solved.

branding.brand_signature: A personified AI coordinator you CC like a person
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch listed, no merch or fan evidence found

brand_strength.rationale: Pleasant personified voice but little press about the brand; name is shared with unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: Vela is a Winter 2026 company still operating in late 2026 with active job postings and a reported team of 15. Aggregators report a roughly $500K seed but no verified round exists in primary sources. It faces fast copying by funded incumbents like GoodTime and Joveo, so its niche in executive search is the main differentiator. No outcome yet.
notes: Unverified: Dealroom, Caplight and Remowork report a $500K seed (Caplight dates a last round 2026-03-24, labeled accelerator; Remowork lists Y Combinator, Pareto Holdings, Z Fellows, Cory Levy). All are aggregators, so not recorded as a round. Product Hunt launch date conflicts between sources (February and July 2026). Not related to Vela Partners.
